name: Smart Video Viral
intro: Smart Video Viral is a feed of trending AI image and video prompts from X. Browse what's working for other creators, then make your own version.

features.search: The search box matches prompt titles, text, tags and authors. Press the slash key to jump straight to it and look up a subject like sneaker or rain.
features.filters-and-sorting: Combine the Images and Videos buttons with the Category, Model and Sort lists to narrow a huge feed down to just the prompts you need.
features.categories: Browse by type of content, from product ads and cinematic to food, travel and UGC. You can also click a category pill to filter.
features.exclude-chinese-toggle: This toggle hides Chinese language prompts, which is on by default. Switch it off when you want even more ideas.
features.copy-prompt: Copy Prompt puts the full prompt text on your clipboard, ready to paste into any studio.
features.create-this-style: Create This Style opens a creation studio with the prompt already filled in, so you go from inspiration to your own version in one click.
features.source-and-view-full-prompt: Source opens the original post on X to credit the author, and View Full Prompt lets you read the whole thing when it's long.

outro: That's Smart Video Viral. Find a prompt you love, make it your own, and keep checking back because the feed refreshes on its own.
